label: Sabhamandapa (Hall of 52 Solar Pillars)
description: Exquisitely carved octagonal open pillared assembly hall featuring 52 sculpted columns depicting scenes from the Ramayana, Mahabharata, and aspects of the 52 weeks of the solar year.

iconography.thematic_meaning: Astronomically aligned with the equinox; sunlight at equinox passed directly through this hall into the garbhagriha.

label: Ornamental Kirti-Torana Gateway Arch
description: Free-standing ornamental triumphal gateway arch leading from the Surya Kund stepped tank into the Sabha Mandapa, featuring delicate cusp arches and makara gargoyles.

iconography.thematic_meaning: Sacred threshold marking the transition between the ritual bathing waters and the divine sanctuary.
